source_name: TEB Sh.A. Kosovo – careers (own site + LinkedIn postings)
why_relevant: TEB routes applications through its own web page and posts roles such as 'Payment Intern' on LinkedIn — direct evidence of payments-function staffing at a BNP Paribas-affiliated bank.

source_name: LinkedIn – Kosovo bank company/job pages
why_relevant: Banks in Kosovo (TEB, Raiffeisen career page, NLB, BKT) post roles and partnership/award announcements on LinkedIn, often earlier and with more technical detail than on their own sites; headcount trends per company are also visible.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës) – news & events
why_relevant: Publishes forums, workshops and partnership announcements (Payments Forum 2025 with Visa; instant-payments/TIPS-clone workshops with the CBK; roadshows in Prizren). Agendas and sponsor lists are a direct map of which banks and vendors are investing in which payment rails, ahead of formal disclosure.

source_name: Kosova Finance Forum (annual, Pristina)
why_relevant: Flagship Kosovo financial-sector conference (2nd edition April 2026, theme 'Building Trust in Western Balkans Financial Markets') with 50+ speakers incl. EIB, IMF, RCC and regional central bank governors; agenda topics (digitalisation of banking services, FDI) and sponsor lists are leading indicators of sector priorities.

source_name: Telegrafi – fintech/crypto/banking event coverage (tag: Shoqata e Bankave)
why_relevant: High-volume Albanian-language outlet that reliably covers Kosovo banking conferences, sponsorships and regional crypto/digital-money conferences in Pristina; its tag pages act as ready-made pointer feeds to events not announced in English.

source_name: STIKK – Kosovo ICT Association (KosICT festival, ecosystem forum)
why_relevant: Organiser of KosICT (13th edition 2024) and the Kosovo Startup Ecosystem Forum; ProCredit Bank Kosova is named general sponsor of KosICT — sponsorship of the country's main tech festival is a direct, early marker of a bank's digital positioning and of fintech-adjacent talent supply.

source_name: Innovation Centre Kosovo (ICK) – events, hackathons, incubator cohorts
why_relevant: Kosovo's main startup incubator; runs hackathons and specialised incubator editions including a 'Women and FinTech' edition. Partner/sponsor logos and startup cohorts identify emerging fintech actors and which banks are backing them.

source_name: Euromoney Awards for Excellence – Kosovo national winners
why_relevant: Annual, country-level award pages naming Kosovo's best bank / best bank for consumers (e.g. NLB Banka 2025). Award citations summarise the strategic claims banks themselves submitted — a compact, comparable read on positioning, and a reliable annual anchor point.

source_name: BKT Kosova – awards & press announcements
why_relevant: Bank's own newsroom republishes awards (Global Banking & Finance Review) and association memberships; award self-announcements reveal which categories (digital, innovation, retail) the bank is competing in, i.e. where it wants to be seen investing.

source_name: KOHA.net – marketing/advertorial and banking award coverage
why_relevant: Major Kosovo outlet whose 'reklama-marketing' section carries bank-supplied announcements of awards, sponsorships and partnerships (e.g. NLB Banka Euromoney 2025) — effectively a bank press-release channel that is indexed and free.

source_name: Regional AI Hackathon (Albania/Western Balkans, incl. Kosovo participants)
why_relevant: Regional hackathon explicitly including Kosovo participants; regional bank-run hackathons (Raiffeisen AI Hackathon in BiH, Garaža FinTech AI Hackathon Belgrade, BoC Fintech Hackathon) are the template Kosovo banks are likely to copy — tracking them gives early warning of formats and vendor partners entering XK.

source_name: Fintech Kosovo (community page, Pristina)
why_relevant: Community/meetup page for Kosovo fintech; such pages typically announce meetups, speaker sessions and bank/vendor partnerships months before institutional channels. Low credibility individually, high early-warning value.

source_name: KlikDoPosla – Serbian-language job ads for Kosovska Mitrovica / North Kosovo
why_relevant: One of the few channels carrying Serbian-language vacancy ads for North Kosovo, where Serbian-system banking/payment operations and their staffing are otherwise invisible to sq/en-only monitoring.

source_name: BQK — Mbrojtja e Konsumatorit (Consumer Protection / complaints hub)
why_relevant: Central Bank of Kosovo's consumer-protection division page: complaint rules, procedures, and the entry point to complaint statistics against banks, MFIs, NBFIs, insurers and pension funds. The authoritative Kosovo-wide conduct/complaints channel.

source_name: BQK — Electronic complaint submission portal (ankesat.bqk-kos.org)
why_relevant: Live e-complaint intake system for financial consumers; may expose categories/typology of complaints and forms that reveal which conduct issues are formally recognised.

source_name: BQK Annual Report / Raporti Vjetor (SQ) — consumer-protection and complaints chapter
why_relevant: Annual reports carry the yearly count and breakdown of consumer complaints by institution type, plus supervisory examination counts — the only consistent multi-year complaint time series for Kosovo.

source_name: CBK Godišnji Izveštaj (Serbian-language annual report)
why_relevant: Serbian-language edition of the BQK annual report; confirms complaint counts (e.g. 1,188 complaints handled in 2025; 1,211 in 2019) and gives sr-language terminology for cross-checking. Useful for Serb-majority-market coverage.

source_name: BQK — Tarifat dhe ngarkesat e BQK-së (central bank's own fee schedule)
why_relevant: Published fees the central bank charges banks for interbank settlement/clearing — an upstream cost input to retail payment pricing, and a baseline against which bank tariffs can be compared.

source_name: BQK legal framework — Rregullore për qasje në llogari pagese me shërbime bazike (basic payment account regulation)
why_relevant: Mandates basic payment accounts and the associated fee-transparency/comparability duties on banks — defines what tariff information banks are legally required to publish.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për Sistemin e Pagesave Ndërbankare (interbank payment system regulation)
why_relevant: Governs the national interbank payment system including participation and fee mechanics; the closest Kosovo analogue to interchange/scheme-fee rulemaking.

source_name: Autoriteti Kosovar i Konkurrencës — Vendimet (decisions register)
why_relevant: The competition authority's published decisions; the venue where any Kosovo ruling on bank fees, interchange, cartel conduct or abuse of dominance would appear. Also publishes annual reports to the Assembly (due 31 March).

source_name: Autoriteti Kosovar i Konkurrencës — Përqendrimet (merger notifications)
why_relevant: Merger/concentration filings and clearances; banking and payments M&A in Kosovo (bank acquisitions, PSP consolidation) surfaces here before or alongside company announcements, often with market-share reasoning.

source_name: Zyra Kombëtare e Auditimit (National Audit Office) — audit report on the Competition Authority
why_relevant: Audits of the Competition Authority (and other regulators) expose capacity, caseload and enforcement-gap realities that explain why few bank-fee rulings exist — a credibility check on the enforcement channel itself.

source_name: MINT — Departamenti për Mbrojtjen e Konsumatorit (Consumer Protection Department)
why_relevant: Ministry department that drafts consumer-protection policy and publishes periodic complaint statistics (e.g. 1,567 complaints Jan–Jun 2026). Covers commercial conduct including pricing disclosure; complements BQK's financial-only mandate.

source_name: konsumatori.rks-gov.net — national consumer complaint platform
why_relevant: Government online complaint platform (with 0800 11000 hotline) through which the MINT complaint statistics are generated; may publish aggregate complaint categories including financial services.

source_name: Institucioni i Avokatit të Popullit (Ombudsperson) — annual reports
why_relevant: Ombudsperson annual reports document complaints and recommendations against public authorities including the central bank and regulators; occasionally cover financial-consumer grievances and access-to-service issues.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosovo — Çmimorja (published price lists, private and business)
why_relevant: Mandated bank tariff publication with effective dates; a directly comparable, dated fee series for accounts, cards, transfers and packages. Effective-dated PDFs allow price-change tracking over time.

source_name: NLB Banka Kosovë — Çmimorja për klientë individual
why_relevant: Retail tariff catalogue of a top-tier Kosovo bank, with effective dates; core input for cross-bank fee benchmarking.
